observed_failure: All 20 Pilot 8 tests errored during setUp before endpoint assertions because the reconciliation table did not exist when the composite journal attempted to compute the reconciliation digest.
root_cause: The Pilot 8 fixture initialized DurableConvergencePermitAuthority but omitted initialization of the production convergence_reconciliation schema owned by UseTimeCheckpointAuthority.
classification_basis: The failure occurred before any P8-01..P8-20 mechanism assertion. Existing Pilot 1-7 regressions remained green in the same run. Therefore this run is not evidence that the Pilot 8 mechanism passed or failed.
allowed_repair: Initialize the existing production reconciliation schema in test setUp using UseTimeCheckpointAuthority without changing Pilot 8 scientific endpoints, expected outcomes, or mechanism semantics.
